content: Akúlu Mʋ́a Aká
Atsɩ, mlɩbu mlɩ akúlu alɩ kɛ́n, mɛ́nɩ nɩ́ amʋ́tɔ́ akʋ bʋmɔhɔ Bulu asʋ́nsʋ́ gyi kʋ́ráá, bowun mlɩ tsiátɔ́ a, ɩbɛ́tsɛ amʋ́, megyí mlɩ obétepí trá bláa amʋ́ asʋansʋ.
Tsúfɛ́ bówun mlɩ tsiátɔ́ wankláán pʋ́ alɩá mlɩtɛhɩ́ɛ́ bú atɔ́.
Mlɩ alɛ́ ɩmátsu mlɩ imi bwɛ, atati yílé dɩdá ntɛ́ɛ sika atɔ́á ɩbʋ ibíá watɔ.
Mboún mlɩha mlɩ alɛ́ itsu mlɩ klʋntɔ. Alɛ́á ɩtamayíntá gyí mʋ́á ɩbʋ alɛ́, ilolwií. Mʋ́tɛhɩ́ɛ́ gyi Bulu ansɩ́ nɩ́.
Tsúfɛ́ alɩ kɛ́n bɩ́mbɩ́ ámʋ atsɩá bɔpʋ amʋ́ ɩwɩ há Bulu, pʋ́ ansɩ́ dɩ́nká mʋsʋ bobu amʋ́ akúlu, sʋ bɔwa akɩ́lɛ nɩ.
Alɩ kɛ́n Sara lóbu mʋ kulu, oletsiá tɩ́ mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ wíe” nɩ. Mʋ abí mlɩgyí, nɩ́ mlɔbwɛ́ yilé, mlɩménya tɔtɔ ifú.

Alɩ kɛ́n mlɩ ayin ɛ́, nɩ́ mlɩa mlɩ aká mlɩbʋ ɩnʋ á, mlɩbɩ ánɩ́ bʋma awútɔ́ ɔwʋnlɩ́n fɛ́ mlɩ. Mlɩwun amʋ́ nwɛ, amlɩpʋ obú ha amʋ́. Tsúfɛ́ mlɩa amʋ́nyɔ obénya Bulu atokiehɛ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ igyi nkpa ámʋ. Mlɩkɩta mlɩ aká tsʋn ɔkpa ánfɩsʋ, mɛ́nɩ nɩ́ mlɩdɛ́ mpáɩ bɔ á, tɔtɔ méetin mlɩ ɔkpa.
Ipianwúun Yilébwɛ Sʋ
Ɩtráhɛ-tráhɛ a, mlɩ fɛ́ɛ́ mlɩha mlɩ agywɩɩn ɩbwɛ kʋlɛ. Mlɩsu ha aba, amlɩdwɛ mlɩ aba Akristofɔ. Mlɩwun aba nwɛ, amlɩba ɩwɩasɩ ha aba.
Mlɩmápʋ lalahɛ ká lalahɛ ɩkɔ. Ntɛ́ɛ nɩ́ ahá besíá mlɩ á, mlɩmásia amʋ́ ká ɩkɔ. Mboún mlɩyula amʋ́, tsúfɛ́ Bulu lɛ́tɩ mlɩ ánɩ́ mlɩbóyulá ahá, mɛ́nɩ obóyulá mlɩ.
Bɔwanlɩ́n wá Bulu asʋ́n ámʋtɔ bɛɛ,

content.text: “Nɩ́ ɔkʋ déklé ɔbɛ́ɛ, mʋ tsiátɔ́ ɩwá alɛ́,
mʋ́mʋ́ osíi ahá ɩwɩ asʋn laláhɛ blɩ́,
Tsúfɛ́ Bulu ansɩ́ bʋ yilé abwɛpʋ́sʋ́.
Ɔtɛyaa asʋ nú amʋ́ atɔ kʋlɩ́hɛ́.

content: Ma ɔbɔ́pʋ lalahɛ gyi mlɩ, nɩ́ mlɩ ansɩ́ ɩpɛ́ yilébwɛsʋ?
Támɛ nɩ́ ɩlɛba ánɩ́ mlɩdɛ́ ipianwúun yilébwɛ sʋ kʋ́ráá á, nwun láwá mlɩ olú. Opúni mátsií mlɩ, mlɩmánya ɔhaa ɛ́ ifú.

Mboún mlɩbɩ tsu mlɩ klʋntɔ ánɩ́ Kristo gyí mlɩ Wíe, mʋ ɩwɩ lɛtɩn. Mlɩda ɩwɩsʋ, mɛ́nɩ brégyíbrɛ́ nɩ́ ɔkʋ lɛ́fɩtɛ́ hógyi ámʋ́ʋ́ ɩbʋ mlɩtɔ ámʋ ɩwɩ asʋ́n á, mlɛ́bɩ lɛ́ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ wankláán. Támɛ mlɩnya klʋn, amlɩba ɩwɩasɩ lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́.
Mlɩ klʋn máha mlɩ pɔ́n tɔtɔ ɩwɩ, mɛ́nɩ nɩ́ bʋdɛ asʋn laláhɛ blɩ́ tsú mlɩ tsiátɔ́ wankláán ámʋ́ʋ́ mlɩlɔ́pʋ mlɩbuo Kristo amʋ ɩwɩ á, pɛ́lɩ bɛ́kɩtá amʋ́.
Nɩ́ igyi Bulu apɛ́ ánɩ́ fʋwúun ipian kʋ́ráá á, ɩbʋ alɛ́á fówun ipian yilébwɛ sʋ, dʋn ánɩ́ fówun ipian lalahɛbwɛ sʋ.
Tsúfɛ́ Kristo ɛ́ lówu ahá lakpan sʋ ɔtsáwʋlɛ pɛ́. Mʋ asʋ́n da ɔkpa, támɛ olowu há lakpan abwɛpʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́, mɛ́nɩ ɔbɛ́kpa mlɩ ba Bulu wá. Bɔmɔ mʋ nyankpʋsa-oyí, támɛ Bulu lɔ́kʋsʋ́a mʋ Ɔŋɛ́tɔ́.
Ɔlɔtsʋn Ɔŋɛ́ ámʋtɔ yɛ́da asʋ́n ámʋ ɔkan há afúli amʋ́ʋ́ bʋda obu ámʋ.
Afúli amʋ gyí, ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋmobu Bulu asʋ́n, Bulu lénya klʋn há amʋ́ brɛ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ anɩ náin Noa dɛ́ dáka kpɔnkpɔɔnkpɔntɩ sré ámʋ. Ahá ikwe pɛ́ lɔ́tsʋn ntsubʋlá ámʋtɔ nyá nkpa.

Ntsu ánfɩ lɛ́lɩɩ́ há asúbɔ. Alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ ahá ámʋ bɔtsʋn ntsubʋlá ámʋsʋ nyá nkpa ámʋ a, alɩ kɛ́n asúbɔ ánfɩ dɛ́ mlɩ nkpa hɔ́ɔ nɩ. Megyí mlɩ ɩwɩ ifin asúbɔ tɔfwɩ́. Mboún igyi ɩpabwií há Bulu ánɩ́ mlɩ klʋn ɩdɩ́ mlɩ asɩ, ɩmátrá ha mlɩ pɔ́n. Asúbɔ ánfɩ lahɔ mlɩ nkpa tsʋn Yesu Kristo kʋsʋ́ tsú afúlitɔ ámʋsʋ.
Alayɔ́ ɔsʋ́sʋ́ yétsiá Bulu gyɔpɩsʋ séi. Bulu-abɔpʋ, ɔŋɛ́tɔ́ awíe pʋ́ túmi kugyíkʋ bʋbʋ mʋ asɩ.
